---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of the problem. E.g. «I'm always frustrated when [...]»

## Proposed solution

What you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other solutions you've considered, and why they don't fit.

## Scope

- [ ] Single-player only
- [ ] Multiplayer too
- [ ] New content (items, monsters, classes, biomes)
- [ ] UI / UX change
- [ ] Balance change
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Bug fix

## Mockup / sketch

If it's a UI change, attach a sketch or screenshot of a similar feature
in another game.

## Implementation notes (for maintainers)

Which modules would this touch?

- `core/` — game rules
- `game/` — single-player UI
- `render/` — drawing
- `net/` — multiplayer
- `audio/` — sound

Tests required: yes / no.
Save format bump needed: yes / no.
